# REST API: Glossary

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from openapi.json. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

These routes of the platform API come from its [OpenAPI document](../openapi.json); [The REST API as a contract](../rest-api.md) says what Lakana promises about them.

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/terms`

List the environment's glossary terms, sorted by key

Each term shows its texts in your language (`lang`, else your profile's language, else `Accept-Language`, else the instance's main language); a text without a translation shows in the main language. Without `READ_ENVIRONMENT` the page is empty, as for an environment that does not exist. A link appears only when you may read its table, or when its table does not exist (`missing: true`). Answers 404 when the environment does not exist and you may read environments, and 422 for a `lang` that is not a language tag, a cursor this list did not issue, a `repository` over 255 characters, or an `owner` or `repository` with a control, format or surrogate character or a line separator (such as NUL).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `owner` | query | no | text or null | Only terms with exactly this owner. |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | Only terms this repository defines. |
| `lang` | query | no | text or null | The language of the texts, such as de or fr-CH; without it, your profile's language, then Accept-Language, then the instance's main language. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most terms returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `TermPage` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `TermPage`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | list of `TermOut` | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | text or null | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/terms/{key}`

Show one glossary term

The texts come in your language (`lang`, else your profile's language, else `Accept-Language`, else the instance's main language); a text without a translation shows in the main language. Without `READ_ENVIRONMENT` the answer is the 404 of a missing term. A link appears only when you may read its table, or when its table does not exist (`missing: true`). Answers 404 when the environment or the term does not exist, and 422 for a `lang` that is not a language tag or a `key` no term can have: over 63 characters, or with a control, format or surrogate character or a line separator (such as NUL).

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `key` | path | yes | text | The term's id in the glossary. |
| `lang` | query | no | text or null | The language of the texts, such as de or fr-CH; without it, your profile's language, then Accept-Language, then the instance's main language. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `TermOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `TermOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | text | yes |  |
| `id` | text | yes |  |
| `name` | text | yes |  |
| `definition` | text | yes |  |
| `synonyms` | list of text | yes |  |
| `owner` | text | yes |  |
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `language` | text | yes |  |
| `links` | list of `TermLinkOut` | yes |  |
| `related` | list of `RelatedTermOut` | yes |  |
| `related_by` | list of text | yes |  |
